title: FB-009 fail closed on invalid WebView API JSON
summary: Fail closed when the WebView API client receives invalid JSON from API routes.
reason: Worker finding FR-025 identified that apiClient.js converted JSON parse failures into successful data for 2xx API responses, violating strict JSON route handling.
behavior_before: A successful HTTP response with non-JSON text returned an object like { error: rawText } to apiGet/apiPost callers, so command and read paths could treat malformed API responses as successful payloads.
behavior_after: apiGet/apiPost throw InvalidApiJsonError on non-empty invalid JSON, including route and HTTP status context; empty successful responses continue to parse as an empty object.
